### Position lock ignores provider **Medium Severity** The new picker lock and `resolveOrderMarginMode` take any same-symbol position from `useHasExistingPosition`, which matches on `asset` only. An isolated BTC position on Lighter then locks Hyperliquid BTC to Isolated and sends `isolated` even when Cross is valid on the selected venue.
Additional Locations (1) - [`app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsProMarketView/components/PerpsProOrderForm/usePerpsProOrderForm.ts#L877-L884`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-mobile/blob/9398d2f0e538f9d9dc449c6b05e16176e9f28022/app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsProMarketView/components/PerpsProOrderForm/usePerpsProOrderForm.ts#L877-L884)

### Refresh locks Cross margin picker **Medium Severity** Opening the margin sheet (and screen refocus) calls `refreshMarginModeLock`, which marks the current request unresolved. `isMarginModeLocked` then treats that in-flight refresh like an unknown lock, so Cross is disabled even when the kept answer is `unlocked`. On a slow lock read, traders cannot pick Cross until the round-trip finishes, and Place Order is held for the same window.
Additional Locations (2) - [`app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsProMarketView/components/PerpsProOrderFormPanel.tsx#L271-L275`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-mobile/blob/40cdf2f5bce5f24ede2f0eb506d62a8a8298e5ba/app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsProMarketView/components/PerpsProOrderFormPanel.tsx#L271-L275) - [`app/components/UI/Perps/hooks/usePerpsMarginModeLock.ts#L110-L115`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-mobile/blob/40cdf2f5bce5f24ede2f0eb506d62a8a8298e5ba/app/components/UI/Perps/hooks/usePerpsMarginModeLock.ts#L110-L115)

body: Not applicable — the fail-closed window is intended. Opening the sheet, refocus and a placed order re-read the venue lock to catch a position, resting order or TWAP opened since the last read. Offering Cross from the kept `unlocked` answer would bring back the case #36918 fixed (Cross offered despite a resting isolated order). The kept answer stays on screen so the label does not flicker. The open sheet re-enables Cross in place when the read returns, one venue round-trip. Place Order is held for that same window so an order cannot carry a mode the fresh read contradicts. Covered by `keeps the previous answer unresolved while a refresh is pending` (usePerpsMarginModeLock.test.ts) and `keeps showing the venue margin mode while the lock is re-read` (usePerpsProOrderForm.test.ts).

body:
Could we carry the selected margin mode into the leverage sheet and TP/SL editor before enabling Cross? This guard removes the isolated liquidation estimate only from the order form. After selecting Cross, opening either editor still calls usePerpsLiquidationPrice, which hardcodes marginType: 'isolated'. The leverage sheet displays that price and liquidation distance; the TP/SL editor also passes it into validation and disables Confirm for stops beyond that isolated threshold. A Cross trader can therefore receive incorrect risk information and be prevented from saving a stop that is valid for their account collateral. Please pass the typed margin mode into both consumers and suppress their isolated estimate and liquidation-based validation for Cross until a cross-aware estimate exists.

Regression proof: This PR first enables selecting and submitting Cross orders from this form, making the unchanged isolated-only editors part of an executable Cross trading workflow; origin/main does not offer that selection.
Supporting trace at the reviewed head:
- usePerpsLiquidationPrice.ts:54 explicitly requests isolated margin.
- PerpsLeverageBottomSheet.tsx:181–192 independently calculates the estimate.
- PerpsTPSLView.tsx:385–412 calculates and forwards it to validation; line 774 disables confirmation when validation fails.
Hyperliquid documents that Cross liquidation depends on account collateral and other positions, and is independent of the selected leverage. The isolated estimate cannot substitute for it. Hyperliquid liquidation rules
action: Fixed typed margin-mode handoffs and suppressed isolated estimates/distance and stop validation for new Cross orders; replied in 4152133881 and resolved thread.

### E2E reasoning
<details>
<summary>Expand to read</summary>

The PR introduces a yarn patch to `@metamask/perps-controller@18.0.1` that adds a new `getMarginModeLock` controller action, plus corresponding Mobile-side hooks (`usePerpsMarginModeLock`), UI changes to `PerpsMarginModeBottomSheet` (enabling cross margin selection), and significant updates to `usePerpsProOrderForm` and `PerpsProOrderFormPanel` to wire up cross margin availability and margin mode locking.

The hard rule seed triggered ALL due to the controller package change in package.json. However, after inspecting the actual patch content and all changed files, the blast radius is narrowly scoped to the Perps trading flow:
- The patch adds a new `getMarginModeLock` method — it does not modify existing controller methods or state shape
- All UI changes are within `app/components/UI/Perps/` — no shared components or cross-feature surfaces are touched
- The locales change adds a new string (`cross_description_available`) without modifying existing strings that E2E selectors might rely on
- No Engine wiring, reducers, selectors outside Perps, or navigation changes

Per the SmokePerps tag description: "When selecting SmokePerps, also select SmokeWalletPlatform (Trending section) and SmokeConfirmations (Add Funds deposits are on-chain transactions)." These dependent tags are included.

Risk is high (not critical) because: the perps-controller patch modifies the distributed package's type definitions and adds implementation code directly into the `.d.ts` files (unusual pattern), and the margin mode selection is a core trading flow that could affect order placement if the lock logic has bugs (as noted in the open PR review comment about refresh locking cross margin picker).

</details>

### Performance reasoning
<details>
<summary>Expand to read</summary>

The PR modifies the Perps order form flow significantly — adding margin mode lock reads (async controller calls) that happen on screen focus and when opening the margin mode sheet. The `usePerpsMarginModeLock` hook adds a new async operation that runs on mount and on refresh, which could impact the responsiveness of the Perps order form. The @PerformancePreps tag covers 'perps market loading, position management, add funds flow, and order execution' — all of which are affected by the new margin mode lock polling.

</details>

With the same symbol on multiple providers, this can use the wrong market restrictions and either hide Cross or offer it for an isolated-only market. Scope the metadata to the selected provider/market and add a regression test with conflicting same-symbol provider records. Re-review the final HEAD after the fix. Review follow-up at 4991fa272b:

- **Bugbot: position lock ignores provider.** Fixed in 15ab6825f3. `useHasExistingPosition` now takes `providerId` and matches on symbol plus provider, so another provider's BTC position can't lock the picker, whichever order the stream lists them in.
- **Fixture bot.** The update workflow's timings fallback called a moved script and failed (run 36233630953). The job runs one fixed spec and never reads the timings, so those steps are gone. The bot then regenerated the fixture (71df866dd0, adds `KycController.providerFlowStatus`), and `Validate E2E Fixtures` passes.
- **Cross eligibility gaps.** Terminal market data drops HyperLiquid's `noCross`/`strictIsolated` restriction, so Pro keeps Cross off while the Terminal backend flag is on (Core fix: [TAT-4022](https://consensyssoftware.atlassian.net/browse/TAT-4022)). Cross also waits for market data to load or refetch before trusting it (d79110149b, 1894887bcf).
- **Line cap and types.** Provider and gating tests are folded into tables to stay under the 1,000-line cap (999). The `lint:tsc` widening in the panel table is fixed in 4991fa272b.

CI on 4991fa272b: green. `Component view tests (2)` failed once in untouched `BridgeView.view.test.tsx:623` (fiat `$0.00` vs `$1.00`). It passes locally (62/62) and passed on rerun; this PR touches no Bridge code.

Deferred: the position-opened timestamp still matches fills by symbol only (predates this PR, no affected caller).

Not merge-ready. There's no device run for this round because the iOS runtime bridge never answered CDP, so the Cross flow hasn't been re-checked on a device since these changes.


[TAT-4022]: https://consensyssoftware.atlassian.net/browse/TAT-4022?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ
